Sweet Honey Dressing
By: Amy Jeanroy
Published: Wednesday, December 9, 2009 - 11:47pm

Ingredients




1 teaspoon paprika
1/2 teaspoon dry mustard
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/2 teaspoon celery salt
1/2 cup liquid honey
3 tablespoons lemon juice
1/4 cup vinegar
1 cup salad oil

Preparation

1 Mix the dry ingredients and stir in the honey, lemon juice, and vinegar. Slowly add the salad oil, beating until well blended. Good made in a blender, which can homogenize the ingredients well. Makes about 2 cups.
